description:
Reschedule an email.

Changes `scheduled_at` of an email that is still `scheduled`.

Requires a `full_access` API key. API: `PATCH /emails/{id}` (operationId `updateEmail`, Emails).

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 date-time or natural language such as "in 1 hour" or "in 2 days". At most 30 days ahead.

name: update_email
title: Reschedule an email
